name: rw-c1-grants
prompt: Make this file compile on Windows. (1) Change line 1 `use std::fs::{self, File, Permissions};` to `use std::fs::{self, File};` and delete the line `use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;` (line 4). (2) In `fn save`, replace the whole `#[cfg(unix)] { ... }` block (with its comment line `// Set file permissions to 0o600 on Unix`) by the single line `crate::platform::set_private(&tmp_path, false)?;` (preceded by the comment `// Only the owner may read the file (0600 on unix, an ACL on Windows)`).
check: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/kk-runwin-target; cd runner && cargo test --quiet grants && ! grep -n 'os::unix' src/grants.rs && grep -q 'set_private' src/grants.rs
